instructions.primary_message: Place milk, cream, and spices in a medium saucepan and stir to combine. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups whole milk
1 cup heavy whipping cream
¼ tsp nutmeg, ground
¼ tsp allspice, ground
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, separate eggs, placing yolks in a medium heatproof bowl and whites in a small bowl. (Reserve egg whites for another use.)
Add sugar and salt to the bowl with the egg yolks. Whisk until mixture is thick, pale, and sugar is fully dissolved, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup granulated sugar
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a ladle, gradually add warm milk mixture to the bowl with the egg yolks, whisking constantly. Return mixture to the pan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until eggnog thickens and reaches 160°F-165°F on a thermometer, 1-2 minutes.
Immediately pour eggnog through a fine mesh strainer into a clean medium bowl. Add 4 fl oz (1/2 cup) whiskey and vanilla, then stir to combine. Cover and chill until cold, about 4 hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
118 ml blended whiskey
1 tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: About 20 minutes before you plan to serve the eggnog, place a clean medium bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)

Just before serving, remove bowl from the freezer. Pour cold cream into the bowl; use a whisk to beat the cream vigorously, until medium-soft peaks form, about 3 minutes. (For medium-soft peaks, when you pull the whisk out of the bowl, the cream should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
Add whipped cream to the bowl with the eggnog and gently stir to combine.
Divide eggnog between glasses and sprinkle with nutmeg. Enjoy!
